title: VLOOKUP vs XLOOKUP
description: Compare VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP to decide which lookup function fits your spreadsheet needs.
intro: VLOOKUP has been the standard lookup function for decades, but XLOOKUP is a modern replacement that fixes many of VLOOKUP's limitations. If you have Excel 365 or Excel 2021, XLOOKUP is usually the better choice.

comparisonTable.functionA: Only searches to the right of the lookup column
comparisonTable.functionB: Can search left or right of the return column

comparisonTable.functionA: Approximate match (TRUE) unless FALSE is specified

comparisonTable.functionB: Uses direct column reference, so column changes are safe
Can return an array of values

whenToUseA: Use VLOOKUP when you share files with users on older Excel versions (pre-2021) or when the return value is always in a column to the right of the lookup column.
whenToUseB: Use XLOOKUP whenever it is available. It is more flexible, safer, and easier to read.
verdict: XLOOKUP is the clear winner for modern Excel users. Only use VLOOKUP for backward compatibility with older versions.

faq.question: Can XLOOKUP replace VLOOKUP in all cases?
faq.answer: Almost all VLOOKUP use cases can be replaced by XLOOKUP, except for 2D array lookups in older versions.

faq.question: Is VLOOKUP deprecated?
faq.answer: No, Microsoft still supports VLOOKUP, but XLOOKUP is recommended for new work.
